name: The Garrow family (old Garrow, his daughter, her two boys)

knowledge.detail: Reported by Arthas: Old Garrow, his daughter and her two boys (who wanted to hold the prince's hammer) lived on a farm in the hills near Strahnbrad. Arthas ate supper at their table on the way up and helped carry them out yesterday. The farm was burned by a band of orcs out of the camps, with axes; it was still burning on the eastern hill at the time of the audience (a small orange flicker under a column of smoke). This is the concrete reason Arthas gives for choosing the orc war.

arc.currentPosition: Dead before the chapter. The orc dead are real.
